summary: Prototype secure core; strict profile schema and backend-owned membership. Emulator coverage is not a production security certification. Media is intentionally unavailable.

findings.issue: Legacy profiles require an explicit administrative migration before rollout.
findings.recommendation: Back up, validate ownership, rehearse migration in staging; do not silently reset user relationships.

findings.issue: Media upload, expiry, physical deletion and post-unlink retention are not implemented; Storage is denied.
findings.recommendation: Complete media lifecycle and tests before opening Storage access.

findings.issue: Real Auth providers, App Check attestation and HTTP callable verification are not exercised by local handler tests.
findings.recommendation: Run a two-account Android staging acceptance test before public release.

attack_outcomes.invalid_membership_transition: all client writes denied; server handshake tested
attack_outcomes.mixed_content_leak: private user documents inaccessible to other accounts
attack_outcomes.orphaned_subcollection: denied when active parent membership missing
attack_outcomes.negative_numeric_overflow: profile accepts no numeric business fields
attack_outcomes.query_mismatch: active app uses own profile/legal/invitation/couple document reads; tested
attack_outcomes.rate_replay: failed lookups consume durable UID limit
attack_outcomes.validator_pattern: user create and update both validate complete schema
